title: Asset Identity
description: Decoded identity for a single physical unit, resolved from a VIN, serial number, UDI, or tail number. One asset_identity record represents one real-world unit and is the join point across every listing/sold_transaction that unit ever appears in — this is what lets Atlas track a specific skid steer or MRI machine across multiple resales over its lifetime, not just score listings independently.

identity_id.description: Referenced by asset.identity_ref on listing and sold_transaction records.

raw_value.description: The VIN/serial/UDI/tail number exactly as captured, before any normalization (case, dashes, whitespace).

normalized_value.description: Uppercased, whitespace/punctuation-stripped form used as the actual lookup key.

input_type.description: hin = hull identification number, for marine assets.

manufacturer_hint.description: Manufacturer as stated by the source listing, used to disambiguate serial-number ranges that collide across brands.

parsed_segments.description: Generic positional breakdown of raw_value for standards with a fixed structure, e.g. {wmc, mds, check_letter, mis} for ISO 10261 earth-moving machinery PINs. Kept free-form rather than named fields so a future identity standard's segment layout is a data change, not a schema migration.

decoder.description: vin_iso3779/nhtsa_vpic for on-road vehicles; manufacturer_serial_table for equipment where each OEM publishes its own serial-number-to-model-year ranges (most construction/ag equipment); udi_gs1 for medical devices; faa_registry for aircraft by tail number; pin_iso10261 for earth-moving machinery Product Identification Numbers (distinct 17-char standard from automotive VIN, see ../ml/pin_iso10261.py).

confidence.description: 1.0 for checksum-validated VIN; lower for serial-range lookups with overlapping bands or missing manufacturer_hint.

checksum_valid.description: Applies to VIN (ISO 3779 check digit) or PIN (ISO 10261 Modulus-23 check letter) only; null for serial-table lookups with no checksum.

ambiguous_candidates.description: Populated when a serial number falls in an overlapping range across multiple models/manufacturers and cannot be resolved to a single decoded record.

linked_records.description: Denormalized index of every record that has resolved to this physical unit. Source of truth for lineage stays the FK on each listing/sold_transaction; this is a convenience cache.
